_comment: E2E (manual, live): agent reads a table in an operator-provided Google Doc, sets a cell, and inserts a row, IN ONE TURN. Replace <YOUR_DOC_ID>. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY + DATABASE_URL + OAuth creds in-memory + --agent-session-id. Uses Docs API (read_tables/set/insert) so a SHARED doc works.

test_payload.prompt: On Google Doc id <YOUR_DOC_ID>, do in order: 1) call gdocs_read_tables and report the first table's dimensions and cell previews. 2) call gdocs_set_table_cell on table_index 0, row 1, col 0 with text 'EDITED'. 3) call gdocs_insert_table_row on table_index 0, at_row 1, insert_below true. 4) Report the verbatim changes and revision_id_after of each step.

config.system_message: You edit Google Docs tables. Always call gdocs_read_tables first to get table_index and coordinates. Report tool results verbatim.
